content: Insurance agent Neha Kapoor emailed customer Saanvi Pillai regarding the expiration of her health policy (Policy No: HP-2024-9876) on August 30, 2026, attaching a renewal brochure with available plans. Saanvi expressed surprise that the policy did not auto-renew and requested information on cost differences between plans, grace periods to avoid coverage gaps, and the final deadline for continuous coverage.

action_items: Provide exact cost difference between current plan and new plan
Confirm if there is a grace period to avoid a coverage gap
Confirm the final date to finalize renewal for continuous coverage
